description: This file defines a rich text WYSIWYG editor component for the Excalidraw application, handling text editing, styling, and user interactions within the drawing environment.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Calculates CSS transform string for positioning, scaling, and rotating the text editor based on app state and element dimensions.

methods.name: textPropertiesUpdated
methods.description: Checks if text properties like font family or size have changed between the element and the editable textarea.

methods.name: updateWysiwygStyle
methods.description: Updates the style and position of the WYSIWYG textarea to match the associated text element, handling container bounds and viewport constraints.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles finalizing text editing, updating element bounds, and invoking the onSubmit callback.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes event listeners and DOM elements related to the WYSIWYG editor.

methods.name: bindBlurEvent
methods.description: Binds focus and blur behavior to manage editing state and refocus the textarea.

methods.name: temporarilyDisableSubmit
methods.description: Disables blur event temporarily during certain interactions like panning.

methods.name: onPointerDown
methods.description: Handles pointer down events for interactions like panning, property menu interactions, and outside clicks.

methods.name: getSelectedLinesStartIndices
methods.description: Returns start indices of selected lines for indentation/outdentation.

methods.name: stopEvent
methods.description: Prevents default behavior and propagation for certain events targeting canvas.
